blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — The Corazon Locsin Montelibano Memorial Regional Hospital (CLMMRH) here has issued a public health advisory about the rise in dengue cases. This situation is based on the surge in the number of on the patients treated in the facility in the last two weeks, mostly coming from various parts of the city. Some 38 of the 50 dengue admissions—representing 76 percent of all cases—came directly from Bacolod City, data recorded by the hospital’s Emergency Department from October 1 to 14 showed.
